title: the live-census tooth plants its own edge
intention: test_encapsulation_holds' live-census tooth stays green when the live repo has no cross-device reach left, and its guard against a vacuous match is a planted edge both readers must find.
why: Measured 2026-11-16 at cairn origin/main: encapsulation_breaches and the tooth's independent path census both read 0 over the live repo, and the tooth is red on its 'an empty census proves nothing' assertion. The guard reds the state RULE 1's children were closing toward.
traces_to: Law 9 (red is distance from the spec; this red measures none). Law 8 (the non-vacuity must stay, so a hollow inspector cannot pass by reading nothing).
how: Move the census loop into _path_census(root); add a tooth over a planted fixture repo that both readers must read alike; drop the non-empty assertion from the live tooth.

clauses.claim: over a planted fixture repo holding one reach from cairn/tools/t into cairn/devices/d's internals and one reach into cairn/devices/d/tools/client (published_by_device true), the path census and encapsulation_breaches each read exactly {(cairn/tools/t/t.py, 2, cairn.devices.d.internal)}
over the live repo the two readers read equal sets, and an empty pair is green

decisions.text: D1: the census loop moves verbatim into _path_census(root) -> set; _rel(root, p) is shared with _inspector_rows(root). A new tooth a_planted_edge_is_read_alike_by_both_readers runs both over _repo(_PLANTED) and sits in TEETH before the live tooth. The live tooth keeps its equality and drops 'assert census'. PROVES gains ca74a1ca8d84 {1: the planted tooth, 2: the live tooth}; 124c0312c2d8 '5' and 56d1aff4455e '7' stay on the live tooth.

measured.saw: encapsulation_breaches over the live repo returned 0 and the path census read 0; the tooth was red on 'an empty census proves nothing' while the other five teeth were green
